title: Finite-horizon reachable domains and no-drift validation

scientific_dispositions.H12_matched_geometry: Finite-horizon structured domain reflects 50% overlap physics for h=1 and full displacement for h=2.
scientific_dispositions.H15_fixed_anchor: Strict anchor binding prevents cumulative floating drift over long sequences.
scientific_dispositions.H16_deterministic_expiry: Deterministic horizon expiration at anchor_step + max_horizon forces fail-closed reference fallback.
scientific_dispositions.H18_finite_horizon: Reachable bounds decay gracefully with horizon length; h>=3 fail closed as unsupported.
